items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Baritone. Baritone. [INTERVIEWEE] Now this guy here, we used to call him Nug.

ctx.x: Oh, I couldn't see. Clarinet. He's a bass drum player. Mm-hmm.

Now this guy here, we used to call him Nug. He's got one hand, that's all I've been known. That's the only name. And he was a bass drum player. Bass drum player. John Porter's brother, he's Joe Porter. Cornet. Second, second cornet. Floyd Jackson, bass player. David Jones, I know you heard of him.
